title: Jammy Springy Australian Blackeye Pea Casserole
description: A comforting Australian dish featuring blackeye peas, lardons, and a jammy sauce, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and serves 6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the diced lardons over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the olive oil, diced onion, and garlic-infused oil, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked blackeye peas and crispy lardons to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
